Frontend dependency provenance

GSAP 3.15.0, SplitText, Flip, and ScrollTrigger — GreenSock standard license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Lenis 1.0.33 — https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
Swiper 11 — MIT license; see SWIPER-LICENSE.txt.
jQuery 3.5.1 — MIT license: https://jquery.org/license/

Published Webflow client runtime, generated page initializers, and generated responsive CSS are preserved for the requested frontend approach. Original notices inside the runtime files are retained. Source URLs and hashes are recorded in source/runtime.lock.json.

Reference font and UI resources have their provenance recorded in source/runtime.lock.json. The existing Leak Properti photographs and video remain in use. Original business contacts, HubSpot scheduling, and external form destinations are not published as Leak integrations.
